text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Gilton Chiwaula, director for Malawi's Anti-Corruption Bureau established early this year, said he will probe unexplained property and wealth acquisition dating back to 1964 when former president Kamuzu Banda became the country's first black prime miniter.
- The Malawi police has laid off 21 police officers including two regional commissioners, but police sources have described the move as normal retirement.
